metadata.description: The Claude Code plugins MaluOS ships under /usr/share/maluos/claude-plugins. Add this directory as a marketplace: /plugin marketplace add /usr/share/maluos/claude-plugins

plugins.name: maluos-office-setup
plugins.description: Configures a freshly installed MaluOS office after first boot: topology, domain, administrator, provisioning, the proxy's names, first sign-in, provider keys and a topology-aware summary
